cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)
project(g1_description)

find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)

# urdf/ and meshes/ are generated by fetch_assets.sh (Unitree's files, not stored in git).
if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/urdf AND EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/meshes)
  install(DIRECTORY urdf meshes DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})
else()
  message(WARNING "g1_description: urdf/ or meshes/ missing, run src/g1_description/fetch_assets.sh "
                  "first. The package builds but RViz will have no robot model.")
endif()

ament_package()
